text_block_list.text: ――And so arrived the Senior year Summer Training Camp.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
choice_data_list: How about we start a little after the sun goes down today?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah. When it's this hot, it's bound to slow down any traveler's pace.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "...I wonder what the atmosphere will be like by the time the Tenno Sho (Autumn) rolls around."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Around the time of the 'Takarazuka Kinen',
how should I put it... it felt like things were starting to gather."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
As the Tenno Sho (Autumn) draws closer...
I feel like that sensation is growing even stronger.
choice_data_list: Wait, all those things gathered there... could it be—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Well, thinking about it won't give me any answers.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I can say this much, though.
It sounds way more fun if we all gather together.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
“The Tenno Sho (Autumn), and the Japan Cup after that...
They seem like they'll be even more extravagant than the Takarazuka Kinen.”

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, look at that face, like a little kid.

Amidst our idle chatter, a thought crossed my mind.
As autumn deepened, what if something was gathering
around her—

...What will happen in the race that lies
at the end of it all, I wonder?

And,
the stage where the most bonds will gather is—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Alright, I'm really getting into the groove now.
choice_data_list: O-Oh, then as expected, the training—

text_block_list.text:
Beyond that stretched a world of pure blue...
and the rich, heady scent of summer—
